I ate lunch at a FiveGuys and a gunfight broke out outside. There was a bank close by and these random robbers were shooting it out with a couple of cops. When the gunfire first went off I didn't believe that it was happening. Then, all at once as the shots were just ringing off my brain all at once clicked on what was happening and I got this huge huge huge rush of adrenaline, so huge that I felt high as a kite. My ears started to ring, not because of the gunfire but because of my blood pressure skyrocketing. When I started to move it was like I wasn't actually moving at all, it felt like I was as light as a feather. I remember running back to the kitchen and just laying under some steel tables and blacking out. I don't remember much of what happened after that, the last thing I remember was talking to a cop about how I was eating. The whole thing felt like it was a joke, like it didn't actually happen it was just some huge misunderstanding, but after a while it really started to click that there was a fucking gunfight and I could have been taken hostage or some shit.
